hook_line: RAMAYANA PASSES DHURANDHAR 2 IN THE US, NEARS RS 1,700 CRORE WORLDWIDE

hook_stat.sub: The highest US total ever for an Indian film — past Dhurandhar: The Revenge at $28.1 million

stats.label: Worldwide gross in 18 days, according to trade tracker Sacnilk
Day 18 net in India, up 28.8% from Day 17, across 16,277 shows
Overseas share of the global gross — Rs 567 crore of the total

diaspora_bullets: For US audiences, the biggest Indian film in American box office history is a Hindi-language mythological epic
Nitesh Tiwari's epic is headlined by Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Yash as Ravana, with Sai Pallavi
news_summary: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana has reached Rs 1,693.50 crore worldwide gross in 18 days, according to trade tracker Sacnilk, and its $28.4 million US total has passed Dhurandhar: The Revenge's $28.1 million to become the highest-grossing Indian film ever in the US.
payoff: For US audiences, the argument is already settled: the biggest Indian film in American box office history is a Hindi-language mythological epic, three weekends into its run.
